items.title: Continuation Anatomy of Periodic Navier–Stokes Breakdown
items.subtitle: A machine-checked H² theory of finite-energy regularity escape.
items.summary: Finite maximality is resolved into bounded kinetic energy, eventual H² divergence, escape beyond every fixed Fourier cutoff, positive-scale regularity, and collapse of uniform continuation reserve.

items.subtitle: Spectral transfer, terminal nonlinear H² work, and simultaneous failure of nonendpoint continuation controls.
items.summary: The continuation anatomy is sharpened through finite-annulus spectral budgets, unbounded terminal nonlinear H² work, and simultaneous failure of nonendpoint continuation regimes.

items.title: Endpoint Rigidity in Periodic Navier–Stokes Flow
items.subtitle: Terminal magnification, intrinsic restart, and analytic rigidity at the L∞t L³x boundary.
items.summary: Bounded terminal L³ forces global continuation, while finite maximal time forces infinite terminal L³ limsup through magnification, restart, backward identification, and rigidity.

items.title: Critical Schwarzschild Scalar Dynamics
items.subtitle: A machine-checked operator theory of terminal self-adjoint laws and Friedrichs selection.
items.summary: A Hardy-critical radial operator with a genuine family of self-adjoint terminal laws is reduced by a ground-state form to the Friedrichs-selected no-log realization.

items.title: Friedrichs-Selected Schwarzschild Quantum Dynamics
items.subtitle: A machine-checked continuum Fock theory and real-scalar physical Cauchy evolution.
items.summary: Friedrichs selection is propagated into positive one-particle frequency, continuum bosonic Fock dynamics, and an independently action-derived physical Cauchy theory.

items.title: Friedrichs-Selected Schwarzschild Quantum Matter
items.subtitle: A machine-checked real-scalar stress theory, physical-clock coherence, and regulator-independent sources.
items.summary: The selected scalar is promoted from quantum dynamics to local spacetime matter through action-derived stress, coherent Fock moments, regulator removal, and explicit quantum sources.

items.title: A Self-Consistent Einstein–Scalar Quantum Sector
items.subtitle: Friedrichs selection, native quantum evolution, and exact gravitational matter.
items.summary: The changed nonlinear geometry owns its own selected quantum law, Fock/Cauchy dynamics, conserved stress, and exact quantum-source branches satisfying Einstein's equation on that same geometry.

items.title: Master-Action Ownership of a Self-Consistent Einstein–Scalar Quantum Sector
items.subtitle: Symmetric-projective BV closure, Palatini descent, and quantum Ward/source exchange.
items.summary: The completed Einstein–scalar sector is traced upstream to an intrinsic symmetric/projective Palatini BV theory whose classical projection binds back to the same native action, source, and clock.

items.title: Quantum Gauge Structure of a Self-Consistent Einstein–Scalar Sector
items.subtitle: Operator BRST representation, a retracted physical Hilbert sector, and projective gauge reduction.
items.summary: A square-zero BRST charge realizes physical cohomology, embeds the native scalar Fock space faithfully, descends native evolution, and removes the Palatini projective quartet cohomologically.

items.title: Regulated Palatini BV Quantization of a Self-Consistent Einstein–Scalar Sector
items.subtitle: Quantum-master obstructions, finite Gaussian BV pushforwards, and restricted physical cohomology.
items.summary: Finite BV regulators support genuine quantum complexes, while Gaussian refinement exposes a first-shell Hamiltonian descent obstruction and canonically leaves a greatest compatible restricted physical complex.

items.title: Relational Quantum Gravity in a Self-Consistent Einstein–Scalar Sector
items.subtitle: Independent physical and gravitational quotients, nonlinear Einstein realization, and intrinsic gauge rigidity.
items.summary: Physical-owner and gravity-visible equivalence relations are globally incomparable, while intrinsic curvature data rigidly recover the source parameter and represented geometry class on the fixed nonlinear family.

items.title: Closed Matter-Current Constraints and Gaussian Physical Moduli
items.subtitle: Bounded-particle exclusion and all-orders Fock structure in a machine-checked gauge-field model.
items.summary: Every nonzero joint closed-current state extends beyond every finite particle cutoff while the same kernel contains an injectively parametrized positive-orthant Gaussian family.

items.title: Pair-Generated Completion of Gaussian Physical States
items.subtitle: Closed quadratic generators, faithful two-particle seeds, and nontruncatable current physicality in a machine-checked gauge-field model.
items.summary: A symmetric pair kernel and canonical quadratic creator reconstruct every even sector; the normalized two-particle seed faithfully recovers the Gaussian modulus.

items.title: From Pair-Generated Fock Structure to Physical Particle Semantics
items.subtitle: Completed Bose/Fock representations, analytic carrier realization, and the boundary of asymptotic particle identity in a machine-checked gauge-field model.
items.summary: The Gaussian pair receives an exact completed Bose/Fock realization with intertwined Poincaré symmetry while asymptotic-particle identification remains a separate boundary.

items.title: Gaussian Pair Geometry and Physical Radiative Response
items.subtitle: Quadratic-sector variational stress, physical-helicity response, and exact information compression in a machine-checked gauge-field model.
items.summary: A faithful three-parameter covariance passes through response maps that retain less information: zero variational stress, one-parameter radiative response, and finally a scale-independent normalized Bose pair.

items.title: Source-Aware Weyl-Reduced Celestial Representation
items.subtitle: Joint source-output symmetry and positive-measure obstruction to fixed-source isometry for radiative two-particle Clebsch–Gordan kernels.
items.summary: Source-aware Weyl reflection admits an exact joint Hilbert reduction, while a positive-measure Gram defect rules out almost-everywhere fixed-source isometric realization of the normalized physical kernel.

items.title: The Physical Celestial Clebsch–Gordan Transform of a Radiative Bose Pair
items.subtitle: Direct-integral completion, source-Weyl geometry, and all-label uniqueness on the intrinsic physical source range.
items.summary: On the intrinsic physical source range, the cross-ratio and full signed principal-series transforms are injective for every physical external-label pair, while the retained bounded completion remains conditional on one explicit uniform core estimate.

items.title: Relational Anatomy of Cell Fate Across Lineage-Resolved Perturbation Experiments
items.subtitle: A finite relational calculus for state, identity, history, and fate across biological systems.
items.summary: Across lineage-resolved perturbation experiments, exact state–fate recovery concentrates near lineage identity while future-selective alignment remains measurable below exactness.
